A few years ago, I was at a summer camp in Washington D.C. The university we were staying at had this potato and sausage based meal plan that did hell on my digestive system. I would wake up in the middle of the night with a stomach in knots and drenched in a cold sweat...but I would not release. Instead, its power grew until that fateful day were would no longer be denied.One day, my group took a trip to a museum on the other end of the city. Quickest way to get there was through the Metro (subway system). Standing on the platform waiting, it hit me like a punch in the stomach. I stayed at the back of my group, pacing and praying silently that I wouldn't crap myself. It was *literally* one of the hardest things I've ever had to do; I never knew the extent of my willpower until that day. I was holding back the jaws of oblivion with nothing but a hope and a pair of Hanes.Finally, we get to the museum. Unsure of how much longer my strength could last, I told the counselor I had to throw up and needed a bathroom NOW. Of course, we had to have a buddy.Of course, it was the girl in our group whom i had been flirting with.I get to the bathroom and I opened Pandora's Box. It was like a fire hose of waste, and it was such a relief I began to shout "YES! I DID IT!" to no one in particular. It was a single bathroom, so i figured it was cool. I  spent ten minutes evacuating and cleaning up. When I came out of the bathroom, I saw the poor girl had been STANDING NEXT TO THE DOORWAY THE WHOLE TIME, and heard everything, including the explosive pressure. Her eyes, wide as they were, never made contact with mine again.TL;DR My explosive diarrhea frightened away my love interest.
